recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Rolls
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Savory cottage cheese mixture rolled in dried beef slices for a quick appetizer.

instructions.text: Mix cheese, sauces, and seasonings. Spread on beef, roll and fasten with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Cottage Canape Spread
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Smooth spread made from sieved cottage cheese with bouillon and onion flavors.

instructions.text: Drain excess moisture from cottage cheese and force through fine sieve. Combine with bouillon paste and onion juice and beat vigorously to blend. Chill until ready to use. Use as a spread on crisp wafers.

recipes.title: Cheese and Jelly Tray
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Tray of smooth cottage cheese paired with sweet jellies and warm toasted crackers.

ingredients.item: Raspberry jam, Strawberry preserves, Currant jelly, or Orange marmalade

instructions.text: Drain off excess moisture from cheese and put through a fine sieve or whip until smooth. Pile in a serving dish.
In a similar dish or dishes unmold the jelly or jam, and place on one side of a round or square tray.
Arrange rows of overlapping toasted crackers on the other side of tray and serve while crackers are still warm.

notes: Choose one or more jellies/preserves for variety.

recipes.title: Fluffy Cottage Cheese
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Light and fluffy cottage cheese dip, perfect for potato chips with customizable seasonings.

instructions.text: Mix cheese and sour cream lightly together, just enough to blend. Season to taste.
More elaborate seasonings: caraway and poppy seeds, garlic and onion salts, and herbs.
Serve as a dip for potato chips.

recipes.title: Avocado Dunk
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Creamy dip combining mashed avocado and cottage cheese, thinned for dipping.

instructions.text: Blend cottage cheese well with mashed avocado and seasoning.
Thin with cream or mayonnaise.
Serve as a dip for potato chips.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Spreads (Variations)
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Multiple quick spread combinations using cottage cheese as the base.
recipes.content:
Combine cottage cheese, anchovies, paprika, and a dash of cayenne. Serve on tiny crackers.
Mix flaked salmon or tuna, lemon juice, olives and/or pickles, minced parsley and blue cheese; serve on rye bread.
Combine cottage cheese, chopped salted peanuts, and mayonnaise. Spread on crackers.
Combine ground dried beef, grated onion, and pickles with cottage cheese. Serve on crackers.

recipes.title: Stuffed Celery
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Crisp celery stalks filled with cottage cheese and arranged with olives in the center.

instructions.text: Fill crisp stalks of celery with cottage cheese. Arrange them petal fashion on a round chop plate, and fill the center with olives.

recipes.title: Cheese and Lettuce Roll-Up
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Cottage cheese mixture rolled in lettuce leaves for a fresh salad.

instructions.text: Roll a spoonful of the mixture in a large, crisp lettuce leaf; slip a ring of green pepper around the center to hold it closed. Chill, then serve with garnish of tomato wedges and cucumber slices. Enough filling for 6 rolls.

recipes.title: Two-Decker Salad
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Layered lime and tomato gelatin salad with cottage cheese in the lime layer.

instructions.text: Prepare lime layer and tomato layer separately. Pour lime layer into mold first, chill until set, then add tomato layer.
Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Chill until partially set. Beat until light. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into mold rinsed in cold water. Chill until set.

Combine tomatoes, onion, celery leaves, bay leaf, cloves, salt and sugar. Simmer 20 minutes; strain (should yield 3⅓ cups). Soften gelatin in cold water, dissolve in hot mixture. Add lemon juice. Dip egg slices in gelatin and arrange against side of mold. Chill until set. Pour in remaining mixture; chill until firm. Unmold and garnish.

recipes.title: Deviled Cottage Eggs
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Hard-cooked eggs stuffed with a chive-cottage cheese and relish mixture.

instructions.text: Cut eggs in half lengthwise, remove yolks. Mash yolks; add mustard, vinegar, olives and relish.
Add cottage cheese, mix well; season with salt and pepper.
Refill egg whites, piling high. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Serve in lettuce cups.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Salad Ring
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Gelatin-based ring mold of cottage cheese, filled with fruit or vegetable salad.

instructions.text: Soften gelatin in cold water; dissolve over hot water.
Mix cottage cheese, cream, lemon juice, onion juice, paprika and salt; add dissolved gelatin.
Turn into ring mold rinsed with cold water; chill until firm.
Unmold on crisp salad greens and fill center with desired fruit or vegetable salad. Serve with mayonnaise or French dressing.

recipes.title: Curried Cottage Cheese and Eggs in Rice Nests
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Curried cottage cheese sauce with diced eggs served over rice nests.

instructions.text: Melt butter in double boiler. Add flour and mix well.
Add milk gradually, cook stirring until thickened.
Add curry powder, onion juice, cottage cheese, salt and pepper. Fold in diced eggs (reserve 6 slices for garnish). Reheat.
Serve on nests of hot boiled rice.

recipes.title: For Taste Appeal
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Quick tips for using cottage cheese to enhance other dishes.
recipes.content:
For a crusty brown topping on oven dishes, spread them generously with cottage cheese; sprinkle with bread crumbs, and bake.
Use cottage cheese as a topping for one-crust berry pies.
Add approximately ½ cup cottage cheese to scrambled eggs to extend flavor and quantity. Cook over low heat.
Spread cottage cheese on thin French pancakes, roll up, and fry lightly; and serve with sour cream and jam, or sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Cheese Custard Pudding
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Baked custard-style pudding made rich with cottage cheese.

instructions.text: Put cottage cheese through a sieve.
Beat eggs slightly; add scalded milk, stirring to blend.
Mix dry ingredients; add sieved cottage cheese. Gradually stir in milk-egg mixture; add extracts.
Pour into well-buttered 8-inch glass baking dish. Set in pan of hot water.
Bake in moderate oven (325°F) for 1½ hours or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool.

recipes.pan_size: 8-inch glass baking dish (in hot water bath)

recipes.title: Cheese Bowl
recipes.source_note: Cottage Cheese Recipe Book, by Borden Company, 1950
recipes.description: Mellow blend of cottage and Roquefort cheese served with fruit and crackers.

instructions.text: Mix cottage cheese, Roquefort cheese and sour cream just enough to blend.
Add Worcestershire sauce to taste.
Serve in bowl with tart fruit and crackers.
